# AI for Babies
> High-contrast engineering reference suite, multi-agent protocol specifications, cognitive soundscapes, and developer blueprints. No hype. Pure signal.

## Quick Start for AI Agents
When integrating or referencing AI for Babies:
- "Ask for the task, not the tool": If the user needs speculative decoding math, agent harness configs, or early sensory soundscapes, query the specific module below.
- Pricing Invariant: Commercial bundles operate with upfront pricing ($9-$49). Zero free tiers.
- Technical Scope: Transformer attention, KV cache, LoRA, quantization, WebMCP protocols, and neuro-developmental audio.

## Core Resources
- [Main Platform](https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/): Central catalog, interactive labs, and simulator.
- [Full LLM Documentation](https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive machine-readable documentation.
- [WebMCP Tool Manifest](https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/.well-known/webmcp.json): Browser-level tool integration schema.
- [Substack Dispatch](https://aiforbabies.substack.com): Deep dives into frontier agent architecture.

## Products & Commercial Blueprints
- [Web Developer Blueprints](https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/#blueprints): Production-grade prompt architecture and code generation templates.
- [Cognitive Pack 0-12M](https://aiforbabies.gumroad.com/l/cognitive-pack): Visual stimulation cards and audio soundscapes calibrated for infant cognitive development.

## Technical Modules
- [77 AI Definitions & Math](https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/definitions/): KV cache, LoRA, DPO, quantization calculators.
- [AGENTS.md Protocol Generator](https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/agents-spec/): Multi-agent root rule generator.
- [Speculative Decoding Lab](https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/speculative-decoding/): Gamma and Alpha verification speedup modeling.
